title: Learning Multinomial Logits in $O(n \log n)$ time
abstract: arXiv:2601.04423v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A Multinomial Logit (MNL) model is composed of a finite universe of items $[n]=\{1,\dots,n\}$, each assigned a positive weight. A query specifies an admissible subset---called a slate---and the model chooses one item from that slate with probability proportional to its weight. This query model is also known as the Plackett--Luce model or conditional sampling oracle in the literature. Although MNLs have been studied extensively, a basic computational question remains open: given query access to slates, how efficiently can we learn weights so that, for every slate, the induced choice distribution is within total variation distance $\varepsilon$ of the ground truth? This question is central to MNL learning and has direct implications for modern recommender system interfaces. We provide both adaptive and non-adaptive algorithms for this task. translated_title: 在 $O(n\log n)$ 时间内学习多项Logit模型
translated_abstract: 多项Logit（MNL）模型由一个有限的物品全集 $[n]=\{1,\dots,n\}$ 组成，其中每个物品被赋予一个正权重。一次查询指定一个可接受的子集——称为一个“选择板”——模型以与权重成正比的概率从该选择板中选择一个物品。这种查询模型在文献中也被称为 Plackett–Luce 模型或条件采样预言机。尽管MNL模型已被广泛研究，但一个基本的计算问题仍未解决：在给定对选择板的查询访问的条件下，我们能以多高的效率学习各物品的权重，使得对于每一个选择板，模型诱导出的选择分布与真实分布之间的总变差距离不超过 $\varepsilon$？这一问题居于MNL学习的核心，并对现代推荐系统界面具有直接的影响。我们为该任务提供了自适应与非自适应两类算法。我们的第一个自适应算法进行 $O(\frac{n\log n}{\varepsilon^2})$ 次查询并精确学习……
tldr: 本文针对多项Logit（MNL）模型的学习问题，提出了自适应与非自适应算法，能够以 $O(\frac{n\log n}{\varepsilon^2})$ 次查询使每个选择板上的诱导选择分布在总变差距离 $\varepsilon$ 内逼近真实分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes adaptive and non-adaptive algorithms for learning Multinomial Logit (MNL) models, achieving $O(\frac{n\log n}{\varepsilon^2})$ queries so that the induced choice distribution for every slate is within total variation distance $\varepsilon$ of the ground truth.
